verses.text: Paul, Silvanus and Timothy, to di church of di Thessalonians wey dey inside Papa God and Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace from God our Papa and Lord Jesus Christ dey with una.
We dey always thank God for una all, as we dey remember una for our prayer dem,
as we no dey stop to remember una work wey faith dey push, una labor wey love dey push, and una patience wey hope for our Lord Jesus Christ dey give, before God wey be our Papa.
Brothers wey God love, we know say God don choose una,
because our Good News no come to una with word only, but with power too, with Holy Spirit and with strong assurance. Una know di kind men wey we be among una for una sake.
Una follow us and follow Lord, as una receive di word inside plenty suffering, with joy wey Holy Spirit give,
so tay una become example to all di people wey believe for Macedonia and Achaia.
Because from una di word of Lord don spread, no be only for Macedonia and Achaia, but for every place una faith for God don reach, so that we no need talk anything.
Because dem demself dey talk about us, how una take welcome us when we come meet una, and how una turn to God from idol dem, to serve God wey dey alive and wey be true,
and to wait for im Pikin from heaven, wey e raise from di dead, Jesus, wey dey save us from di wrath wey dey come.
Brothers, una know say di time wey we come meet una no be for nothing,
but even after we don suffer before and dem don treat us shamefully for Philippi, as una know, our God give us boldness to talk God Good News to una inside plenty struggle.
Because our appeal no come from error, or from dirty mind, or from deceit.
But as God don approve us to hold di Good News, na so we dey talk am; no be to please men, but to please God, wey dey test our heart.
Because una know say we no ever use flattering word, and we no use any cover to hide greed. God na witness.
We no look for glory from men, no be from una and no be from other people, even though we fit don use our authority as apostles of Christ.
But we dey gentle among una, like mama wey dey nurse and take care of im own pikin dem.
So as we dey long for una with love, we gree give una no be only God Good News, but our own life too, because una don become very dear to us.
Brothers, una remember our labor and hard work; as we dey work night and day so that we no go be load for any of una, we preach God Good News to una.
Una na witness, and God too, how we live holy, righteous and without blame among una wey believe.
Una know how we dey advise, comfort and beg every one of una, like papa wey dey do im own pikin dem,
so that una go live in way wey fit God, wey dey call una enter im own Kingdom and glory.
Na why we dey thank God without stop too, because when una receive di word of God message from us, una no accept am as men word, but as e be for truth, God word, wey dey work inside una wey believe.
Brothers, una follow di churches of God wey dey Judea inside Christ Jesus; because una too suffer di same things from una own people, just as dem suffer from di Jews,
wey kill Lord Jesus and dem own prophet dem, and drive us comot, and no please God, and dey against all men,
as dem dey stop us make we no talk to di Gentiles so that dem go save; so dem dey always fill up dem sin. But wrath don come on dem finish.
But we, brothers, don separate from una for small time, for body no be for heart, and we try well well with strong desire to see una face.
Because we wan come meet una, even me Paul, one time and again, but Satan block us.
Because wetin be our hope, or our joy, or our crown to rejoice? No be una be dat, before our Lord Jesus when e come?
Because una na our glory and our joy.
So when we no fit bear am again, we decide say make dem leave us for Athens alone,
and we send Timothy, our brother and God servant for di Good News of Christ, to make una strong and to comfort una about una faith,
so that nobody go shake because of dese sufferings. Because una know say na for dis thing dem put us.
Because when we dey with una, we don tell una before say we go suffer, and na so e happen, as una know.
Na why I too, when I no fit bear am again, send person to know about una faith, because I fear say maybe di tempter don tempt una, and our labor go be for nothing.

But now Timothy don just come back to us from una, and e bring us good news about una faith and love, and say una dey always remember us well, and una dey long to see us, just as we too dey long to see una.
So, brothers, una faith don comfort us about una for all our trouble and suffering.
Because now we dey alive, if una dey stand firm for Lord.
Because wetin thanks we fit give God again for una, for all di joy wey we dey rejoice for una sake before our God,
as we dey pray night and day with all our heart make we see una face and complete wetin dey lack for una faith?
Now make God imself wey be our Papa, and our Lord Jesus Christ, open our way come meet una;
and make Lord increase una and make una overflow for love to each other and to all men, just as we dey do to una too,
so that e go make una heart strong, without blame for holiness, before God wey be our Papa, when our Lord Jesus go come with all im holy people. Amen.
Finally, brothers, we beg and urge una for Lord Jesus, as una don receive from us how una must live to please God, as una dey live now, make una do am more and more.
Because una know di instruction dem wey we give una through Lord Jesus.
Because dis na God will, say make una dey holy: make una stay far from sexual immorality,
make each one of una know how to control im own body for holiness and honor,
no be with passion of lust, like di Gentiles wey no know God;
make nobody cheat or wrong im brother for dis matter, because Lord dey punish for all dese things, as we don warn una before and testify.
Because God no call us for dirty life, but for holiness.
So anybody wey reject dis one no reject man, but God, wey don give una im Holy Spirit.
But about love for brothers, una no need make person write to una. Because God demself don teach una to love each other,
and na so una dey do am to all di brothers wey dey all Macedonia. But we urge una, brothers, make una do am more and more;
and make una try to live quiet, to mind una own matter and to work with una hand, just as we command una,
so that una go live well before dem wey dey outside, and una no go need anything from anybody.
But we no want make una no know, brothers, about dem wey don sleep, so that una no go sorrow like di rest wey no get hope.
Because if we believe say Jesus die and rise again, na so God go bring with am dem wey don sleep inside Jesus.
Because we tell una dis one by di word of Lord, say we wey dey alive, wey remain till Lord come, no go go before dem wey don sleep.
Because Lord imself go come down from heaven with shout, with di voice of di archangel and with di trumpet of God. Di dead wey dey inside Christ go rise first,
den we wey dey alive, wey remain, go join dem and dem go carry us go up inside cloud dem, to meet Lord for air. So we go dey with Lord forever.
So make una comfort each other with dese word dem.
But about di times and di seasons, brothers, una no need make person write anything to una.
Because una know well say di day of Lord dey come like thief for night.
When dem dey talk say, “Peace and safety,” den sudden destruction go come on dem, like labor pain on pregnant woman, and dem no go escape at all.
But una, brothers, no dey inside darkness, so that di day go catch una like thief.
Una all na pikin dem of light and pikin dem of di day. We no belong to di night or to darkness,
so make we no sleep like di rest, but make we watch and keep clear mind.
Because dem wey dey sleep, dem dey sleep for night, and dem wey dey drunk, dem dey drunk for night.
But make we wey belong to di day keep clear mind, as we wear faith and love like breastplate, and di hope of salvation like helmet.
Because God no choose us for wrath, but make we receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
wey die for us, so that whether we dey awake or we dey sleep, we go live together with am.
So make una encourage each other and build each other up, just as una dey do.
But we beg una, brothers, make una respect dem wey dey labor among una, wey dey lead una for Lord and dey warn una,
and make una honor dem with love because of dem work. Make una dey live in peace among una self.
We urge una, brothers, warn dem wey no dey follow order, encourage dem wey fear, help dem wey weak, and dey patient with everybody.
Make una see say nobody pay evil back with evil to anybody, but make una always follow wetin good, for each other and for everybody.
Always rejoice.
Pray without stop.
For everything give thanks, because dis na God will for una inside Christ Jesus.
No put out di Spirit.
No despise prophecy dem.
Test everything, and hold tight wetin good.
Stay far from every kind of evil.
Make di God of peace imself make una completely holy. Make una whole spirit, soul and body dey keep without blame when our Lord Jesus Christ go come.
Di one wey dey call una dey faithful, and e go do am.
Brothers, pray for us.
Greet all di brothers with holy kiss.
I command una seriously by Lord make dem read dis letter to all di holy brothers.
Di grace of our Lord Jesus Christ dey with una. Amen.
